definitions.gloss: historical anecdote, old story, classical tale
definitions.explanation: A story or anecdote from ancient times, particularly from Chinese classics, that has been passed down and often serves as the origin of a proverb or set phrase.

examples.japanese: この{言葉|ことば}には{故事|こじ}がある。
examples.english: There is a historical anecdote behind this phrase.

examples.japanese: {故事|こじ}{成語|せいご}を{使|つか}って{文章|ぶんしょう}を{書|か}く。
examples.english: To write using classical four-character idioms.

examples.japanese: {中国|ちゅうごく}の{古典|こてん}に{由来|ゆらい}する{故事|こじ}は、{日本語|にほんご}のことわざにも{多|おお}く{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: Many historical anecdotes originating from Chinese classics remain in Japanese proverbs.

notes:
USAGE:
Often appears in the compound {故事|こじ}{成語|せいご} (classical idiom based on a historical anecdote) or {故事|こじ}{来歴|らいれき} (history and origin). Many {故事|こじ}{成語|せいご} in Japanese come from Chinese classical literature, such as {矛盾|むじゅん} (contradiction) and {五十歩百歩|ごじっぽひゃっぽ} (pot calling the kettle black).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {故事|こじ}{成語|せいご}: idiom based on a historical anecdote
- {故事|こじ}{来歴|らいれき}: history and origin
- {故事|こじ}に{ちなむ}: to be based on a historical anecdote
- {故事|こじ}にならう: to follow a historical precedent

HOMOPHONE NOTE:
Not to be confused with {誇示|こじ} (display, showing off), which shares the same reading.
